subject: planner: enable FixControl44262 by default if we have tidb_skip_missng_partition_stats (#51405)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: the only production change is in `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go` to default `fixcontrol.Fix44262` (allow dynamic partition prune without global stats) to `SessionVars.SkipMissingPartitionStats` (tied to `tidb_skip_missing_partition_stats`). This affects whether `flagPartitionProcessor` is set / `StmtCtx.UseDynamicPruneMode` is force-disabled and warnings emitted when dynamic pruning is enabled but global stats are missing; no correctness/semantics/data-consistency/privilege/session-transaction issues found. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` and the same behavior remains (no later revert/fix indicating a Blocker/High issue).
